thread:
maya: Starting regionwise rollout for v2.4.1 -> US then EU then APAC. Change window 23:00-03:00 PT. Canary plan: US 5% x12m, EU 3% x12m, APAC 2% then ramp. Need capacity thumbs and version pin. @oliver can you confirm no DB migrations? @sasha ops, can you confirm reserved pools?

oliver: No DB migrations in this release. Staging smoke looked good. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/v2.4.1 (summary added)

sasha: Ops check: reserved pools available. spare GPUs -> us-east1: 24, us-west1: 8, eu-west1: 12, apac-sg: 6. I'll keep a 10% cushion. Recommend pin fallback model on mismatch.

liam: I'll stand by to hold route for EU if latency > 250ms or p95 jumps. What's our explicit rollback trigger?

maya: Rollback triggers: >=5% request_error OR sustained p95 > 500ms for 3m. Canary duration 12m per region, 3m steady-state check before ramp. Documented in runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/region-rollouts

jordan: @deploy-bot please start US canary 5% v2.4.1 with fallback to v2.3 pinned if mismatch

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Initiating canary: region=us, percentage=5, version=v2.4.1, fallback=v2.3. Expected warmup ~90s. Canary ID: cr-1768003123-us-1

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cr-1768003123-us-1 progress: health=OK, p95=120ms, errors=0.2% after 3m. Observability tags: model=vicuna-rwd, quant=fp16

sasha: Loadgen smoke passed against US pool. No regression in output quality. Proceed to EU when ready.

maya: Proceed EU canary if ops & eng sign off. Reminder: EU requires data_residency flag enabled in rollout config. Pin model version on EU fallback.

jordan: @deploy-bot start EU canary 3% v2.4.1 (data_residency=true)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Initiating canary: region=eu, percentage=3, version=v2.4.1, data_residency=true. warming tasks, estimate 2m. Canary ID: cr-1768003123-eu-1

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EU canary cr-1768003123-eu-1 status: p95=220ms, errors=0.6% (above soft threshold). Holding at 3% and notifying oncall.

oliver: I see a tokenizer fallback causing some spikes in EU; stepping through runtime config now. Pushing a hotpatch to EU pool to force tokenization path consistent with US. ETA ~8m.

sasha: Hold EU at 3% until patch applied and re-validated. Do not expand or touch APAC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EU canary paused at 3% by manual hold (sasha).

maya: If EU can't stabilize within 20m, rollback EU to v2.3 only. Keep APAC off the schedule until EU green.

liam: Reclaiming 4 GPUs from APAC warm pool to top-up capacity, ETA 5m. I'll also reserve an extra warm instance for APAC ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Hotpatch applied to EU pool, restarting canary tasks for cr-1768003123-eu-1.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EU canary cr-1768003123-eu-1 now healthy: p95=140ms, errors=0.1%. Clear to schedule APAC.

maya: Green across US+EU. APAC window set for 03:30 PT (local evening). Plan: APAC canary 2% x12m, then 10% ramp if stable. Jordan, schedule APAC canary at 03:30 PT and notify 10m prior.

jordan: Ack. I'll run APAC canary 2% at 03:30 PT and add a 10-min extended observation. Will post status updates here.

sasha: I'll update the release notes with explicit version pins, rollback rules, and the regional holdpoints: https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/v2.4.1/ops

maya: Thanks everyone. Good catch on the tokenizer path. If anyone sees p95 creep or errors >3% during APAC ramp, hit rollback for that region only. :rocket:
